text: Keeps a running list of restaurants to try, ranked by how loud they are.
Reads the acknowledgements page of every book before the first chapter.
Answers work messages within minutes but sits on personal texts for days.
Would rather redo a whole spreadsheet than fix one wrong formula by hand.
Picked a college minor mainly because the building had good light.
Owns exactly one nice coat and wears it until a button falls off.
Plans trips around a single meal, then builds the rest of the day loosely.
Keeps every plant alive except basil, which dies within two weeks every time.
Calls a parent on the drive home from work more often than on weekends.
Has strong opinions about fonts and will say so unprompted in meetings.
Learned to cook from a grandmother and still measures salt by feel.
Buys the same three shirts in different colors instead of shopping around.
Takes the stairs at work but the elevator everywhere else without noticing.
Keeps a shared document with a close friend that neither has updated in months.
Would sooner walk forty minutes than wait ten for a ride.
Says yes to karaoke and then only ever picks the same two songs.
Overpacks for one-night trips and underpacks for two-week ones.
Left a stable job for a harder one mostly to stop being bored.
Marks up a printed page more than the same page on a screen.
Sends long voice messages instead of typing when something matters.
Keeps snacks in a desk drawer for a coworker who never asks for them.
Rewatches the same three comfort movies instead of picking something new.
Wakes up early on weekends by habit, then wastes the extra hour anyway.
Apologizes first in an argument even when not sure they were wrong.
